text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
The National Backgammon Tournament! Our 
special guest is this well-known board 
game enthusiast—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It's Rulership! Fellow comrades, display 
your wits to the fullest and aim for the 
pinnacle of glory!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ruler!! Your racing outfit is awesome! 
It's so stylish and suits you so well~!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Totally~! Those chess and Reversi pins are 
so cool too~♪

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Much obliged, young ladies. I hope you 
enjoy yourselves to your hearts' content 
today.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: —...Phew.
choice_data_list:
Good work. Your racing outfit was a big 
hit.

Good work. Your racing outfit was a big 
hit.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"We're all fellow board game lovers, after 
all. They probably appreciated the 
attention to detail in the outfits."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
My decision to go with this design was the 
right one. Today's applause is proof of 
that. ...Right?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
—A design concept for my racing silks? Ah, 
naturally, I intend to come up with it 
myself.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
An outfit befitting a ruler—one who 
commands every arena, from the racetrack 
to the shogi board.
choice_data_list:
Oh! Looks like a wonderful outfit is 
coming together!

Huh! Looks like it's going to make a 
wonderful outfit!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Constructing the design will be finished 
in no time. You can look forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rulership left in high spirits. I can't 
wait to see what kind of design she comes 
up with!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... My Trainer's eyes were practically 
sparkling.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(Well, of course. It's the racing outfit 
of domi-san, whom she respects, and for 
the Umamusume she supports as her right 
hand.)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(The ruler of the board, my beloved board 
games— Their motif is clear, flowing 
through the very core of who I am. There's 
not a single shred of doubt...!)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Just you wait, Trainer. —Victory in this 
game is already in sight before it even 
begins!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It's no use, it's checkmate, I 
surrender...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(None of the plans are bad... but none are 
the optimal move. No way I'm settling for 
a safe bet! But—)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
......What does "cool" even mean? ...What 
does "stylish" even mean? ...Haha, haha. I 
don't understand anything anymore... It's 
totally over, I'm doomed~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"When I visited the stronghold to bring 
some refreshments, Rulership was 
completely burned out into pure white 
ash."
choice_data_list: …Are you okay? Did something happen?
…Are you okay? Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Should I just ask Trainer for advice? 
Maybe they'll think of a new way to break 
through the current situation...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, idiot! Don't chicken out now! This 
is the gamble of a lifetime!"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It only counts if you clear it without 
anyone's help...! Otherwise, no matter how 
brilliant a match it is—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't be able to stand proud before 
my right hand, nor myself...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: No problem.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm merely undecided on my next move. 
It will be solved shortly—"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Wait, aaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (FLAP FLAP FLAP!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A binder placed on the shelf fell, 
scattering memos and costume sketches 
across the floor."
choice_data_list:
Are these... design proposals for a racing 
outfit?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: A-Ah, ah-wa-wa-wa...
choice_data_list: Hmm, they all look good.
Hmm, they all look nice, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The first stylish dealer-themed one, the 
second tabletop game motif, and the cool 
look matching the earrings in the third—
choice_data_list:
Every piece of it shows a little bit of 
who you are.

Every piece of it shows a little bit of 
who you are.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Part by part... by part... That's it!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(What a miscalculation. I already had the 
cards I needed. The issue was how I built 
the deck...!)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(If I divide the costume ideas into parts 
as cards and construct them to align 
better with the theme—)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It's ready...! This is my racing 
outfit—the ultimate costume deck!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ah... *ahem*. Trainer, the racing outfit 
you ordered has arrived.
choice_data_list: Ooh...!
Wah...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"How's that? The theme, the balance, its 
synergy with me— It's a flawless design 
from every angle, wouldn't you say?"
choice_data_list: So cool...!!
That's exactly how I pictured domi!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Just like a flawless deck—— this 
racing outfit has been constructed 
beautifully, without a single gap.
choice_data_list:
This looks way more refined than the draft 
I saw before!

This looks way more refined than the draft 
I saw before!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh... A flash of inspiration struck me 
after that. From then on, it was finished 
in the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"...By the way, I hear Umamusume who 
receive their Racewear get invited to more 
magazine photoshoots and guest appearances 
at events."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It is troublesome, certainly... but 
looking ahead, raising your profile like 
that could be considered a necessary 
strategy.
choice_data_list:
Let's do it! I want everyone to see more 
of me too!

Let's do it! I want everyone to see more 
of me too!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, of course.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And now— She has become someone who 
captures many eyes. And surely, she will 
continue to do so from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before us stood a cool, collected board 
game player who effortlessly controlled 
every state of the board.
choice_data_list:
That's the idealized image I imagined 
before we ever met.

The idealized image I had imagined before 
we ever met.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: ! Oh, is that so!
choice_data_list:
I can't wait to see you in action in this 
outfit.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I'll have plenty more exposure from 
here on out, and I'll give them the full 
show.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Whether in races or anywhere else— I'll be 
the cool Domi-san you picture in your 
mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And now— She has become someone who 
captures many eyes. And surely, she will 
continue to do so from here on out.
